name: kitsuvo-cloud
description: Browse and inspect sites in your own Kitsuvo browser through the opt-in authenticated cloud connector.

interface.longDescription: Connect to your own installed Kitsuvo browser through the authenticated relay. Start and approve the connector on your computer first. Requested page text, screenshots and reports pass through the relay to your AI client. Closing the connector revokes access. Requires a running Windows or macOS computer.
defaultPrompt: Open this site in Kitsuvo and explain its detection evidence.
Check this page at phone and desktop sizes.
